name: Australian Council of Trade Unions 2012 millionaires tax
detail: Proposal described as a Buffett Rule, a minimum income tax, rather than a tax on net wealth.

name: John Passant
detail: Former tax official advocated a 1% wealth tax in 2014; died 5 April 2020.

name: Australian Progressive Coalition economic justice proposal
detail: The policy calls its measure a wealth tax but defines it as a tax bracket on annual profits.
